page.content:
Winged beings at Josie's who are legally not to be called angels.

How angels connects

  • Character: Old Woman Josie — The angels live with Old Woman Josie.
  • Location: Night Vale — The angels occupy Josie's land in Night Vale.
  • Faction: Night Vale City Council — The City Council forbids both the angels and the word angel.

What is angels?

The angels of Night Vale live with Old Woman Josie, glow, have names like Erikas, and exist in a town whose City Council has forbidden both their presence and the word for them.

Key threads lead to Old Woman Josie, Night Vale and Night Vale City Council.
